designs.name: CAMBRIDGE Camel Overcoat | Double Breasted Wool
designs.description: Camel herringbone wool with wide peak lapels, two rows of horn buttons, welt pockets and a buttoned half-belt on the back. Turnback cuffs with horn buttons on both sleeves.

designs.name: REGATTA Club Blazer | Navy Hopsack + Crest
designs.description: Navy hopsack blazer with notch lapels, a club-striped tie, gold buttons and an embroidered crest on the breast pocket. Three brass buttons on each cuff and a shirt cuff showing at the wrist.

designs.name: BRAEMAR Argyle Knit | Camel + Navy Diamonds
designs.description: Argyle in camel and navy with wine overstitch, wrapping the whole garment seamlessly — the diamond grid divides the wrap exactly so it meets at every seam. V-neck over a shirt collar, ribbed trim.

designs.name: SPRINGVELD Green Rugby Jersey | South Africa Kit
designs.description: Bottle green rugby jersey with a gold polo collar, chevron trim band, raglan shoulders and a technical mesh weave. Leaping buck on the chest, protea shield, and the South African flag on both sleeves. Number 10 and SUID-AFRIKA on the back.

designs.name: SPRINGVELD White Alternate Jersey | SA Away Kit
designs.description: The away colourway — white body with a green collar, gold raglan shoulders and green detailing. Same buck, shield and flag placement, number 7 on the back.

designs.name: SPRINGVELD Pro Match Jersey | South Africa Rugby
designs.description: The detailed match version. Stand-up gold polo collar with lettering, buttoned placket, engineered side panels, raglan shoulders and a fine technical mesh knit. Leaping buck and protea shield on the chest, springbok plus the South African flag on all four faces of both sleeves, deep gold cuffs, and number 10 on the back.

designs.name: NOCTVRNE Black Long Sleeve | Dark Streetwear
designs.description: Black long sleeve with a glitched wordmark on the chest and a gothic cross burst on the back. Repeating text runs down all four faces of both sleeves.

designs.name: REBEL SOVL Winged Skull Tee | Y2K Faded Black
designs.description: Faded black tee with a chrome winged skull on the chest and a full wingspan on the back. Short sleeve, so the forearms show your own skin tone.

designs.name: ESSENTIALS Cream Puff Tee | Clean Fit Aesthetic
designs.description: Cream long sleeve with raised puff print on the chest and back, ribbed cuffs and soft fabric shading. Goes with beige, brown, black or grey.

designs.name: VOIDKID Layered Emo Tee + Chain
designs.description: White tee layered over a black long sleeve, with a silver chain around the neck, a checkerboard band on the sleeves and star graphics front and back.

designs.name: ROVERS 96 Football Jersey No.10 | Blokecore
designs.description: Vintage football kit with a club crest, sponsor print, wrapped sleeve stripes and a big number 10 on the back. Short sleeve with a navy cuff trim.

designs.name: ALPNX Quilted Puffer Jacket | Winter Drip Fit
designs.description: Quilted nylon puffer with real channel shading, centre zip and reflective back stripe. Channels line up all the way round the torso and both sleeves, so it reads as a jacket from every angle. Orange tab detail on the chest.

designs.name: RIVET CO Denim Trucker Jacket | Vintage Wash
designs.description: Indigo trucker jacket with a real twill weave, gold contrast topstitching, buttoned chest pockets with flaps and a faded shoulder yoke. White tee collar peeks through at the neck.

designs.name: APEX Moto 07 Racing Jersey | Orange Motocross
designs.description: Motocross number board on the back, sponsor patches on the chest and a checkered flag band wrapping both sleeves. Orange diagonal sweep carries across the front, back and sides.

designs.name: N3ON Cyber Grid Tee | Neon Vaporwave Glow
designs.description: Perspective neon grid running to a magenta horizon sun, with a cyan tech ring emblem on the back and scanlines over the whole garment. Neon trim bands wrap both sleeves.

designs.name: CAMPUS 88 Varsity Letterman | Green Chenille
designs.description: Cream body with forest green raglan sleeves, a fuzzy chenille letter patch on the chest and striped rib trim at the collar, cuffs and hem. Arched team text and a big 88 on the back.

designs.name: MIDNIGHT Tailored Suit Blazer | Formal Roleplay Fit
designs.description: Charcoal blazer with peak lapels, a crisp shirt collar, striped tie and pocket square. Cuff buttons on both sleeves and a centre vent on the back. Pairs with the matching trousers.

designs.name: NOTHING Oversized Hoodie | Baggy Black Fit
designs.description: Charcoal hoodie with the hood sitting on the shoulders, real drawstrings with gold tips and a kangaroo pocket. Ribbed cuffs and hem, tonal print down all four sleeve faces.

designs.name: WESTBROOK Prep Sweater Vest | School Uniform Fit
designs.description: Navy cable-knit vest over a white shirt with a gold-striped tie and a letter patch. White shirt sleeves with cuff buttons. Built to wear with the tartan skirt.

designs.name: SUGARDROP Pastel Cutecore Top | Soft Girl Bow
designs.description: Baby pink top with a lace collar, a big satin bow and scattered hearts and stars. Puffed shoulder shading and lace-trim cuffs.

designs.name: LACEWING Corset Top | Pastel Goth Coquette
designs.description: Black top with pink ribbon corset lacing down the front, lace trim at the collar and cuffs, gothic cross on the back and bows on both sleeves.

designs.name: CEDAR Flannel Over Tee | Buffalo Plaid Layered
designs.description: Red buffalo plaid overshirt worn open over a white tee, with chest pockets, buttons and rolled sleeve cuffs. Full plaid back and sleeves.

designs.name: IRONSIDE Leather Biker Jacket | Asymmetric Zip
designs.description: Black leather jacket with a real specular sheen, an off-centre diagonal zip, zip pockets, a waist belt and quilted shoulders. Studded sleeve straps and a club print on the back.

designs.name: FAIRYFLOSS Butterfly Baby Tee | Y2K Rhinestone
designs.description: Pale pink baby tee with a gradient butterfly, rhinestone lettering and a rhinestone trim along the collar and sleeve hems. Sparkles scattered across the body, short sleeve so the forearms stay bare.

designs.name: GLAMOUR Velour Zip Track Top | Y2K Tracksuit
designs.description: Hot pink velour zip-up with a real nap sheen, metal zip teeth, white piping down both sleeves, zip pockets and rhinestone lettering across the back. Pairs with the matching track pants.

designs.name: HEATWAVE Airbrush Tee | 2K4 Bubble Letters
designs.description: White tee with soft airbrushed colour blooms and chunky outlined bubble lettering front and back, plus scattered stars. Boardwalk airbrush-stand energy.

designs.name: ROSEMEAD Cricket Cable Knit | Old Money Tennis
designs.description: Cream cable-knit sweater with braided cables running down the body and sleeves, navy and wine club stripes at the V-neck, cuffs and hem, and a shirt collar showing underneath.

designs.name: CAP FERRAT Linen Camp Shirt | Riviera Old Money
designs.description: Sand linen shirt with a slub weave, open camp collar, shell buttons, a chest pocket and a back yoke. Short sleeve with a turn-back cuff.

designs.name: HAWTHORNE Quilted Field Jacket | Country Old Money
designs.description: Olive diamond-quilted jacket with a tan corduroy collar and cuffs, brass studs, flapped pockets and a storm placket. Countryside estate energy.

designs.name: INFERNO Flame Wrap Shirt | All Over Fire Print
designs.description: Flames climb from the hem and wrap right around the body and both sleeves with no seam anywhere — under the arms, across the back, over the shoulders. Matching flame pants available.

designs.name: NEBULA Galaxy Wrap Shirt | All Over Space Print
designs.description: A full nebula in violet, magenta and cyan wrapping the entire garment, scattered with stars. Continuous across every face including the shoulders and under the arms.

designs.name: MAGMA Lava Crack Shirt | Glowing Cracked Rock
designs.description: Black volcanic rock split by glowing lava veins that flow unbroken around the torso and both sleeves, with a heat glow rising from the hem.

designs.name: OVERCLOCK Circuit Shirt | Neon Tech All Over
designs.description: A glowing circuit board wrapping the whole garment — bus lines, solder pads and chips in neon cyan and green, continuous around every face.

designs.name: LIQUID CHROME Shirt | Iridescent Oil Slick
designs.description: Molten chrome with a rainbow oil-slick sheen flowing around the entire garment. Rendered from a height field, so the highlights bend like real polished metal.

designs.name: STATIC Core Tee | Black Glitch Logo
designs.description: The core black tee. Small chromatic-split logo on the chest, full wordmark across the back with signal-tear bars, scanlines over the whole garment and STATIC running down all four faces of both sleeves.

designs.name: STATIC Core Long Sleeve | White Colourway
designs.description: The inverse colourway. Black wordmark on off-white with cyan and red fringing, tear bars front and back, and a cyan/red stripe pair above each cuff.

designs.name: STATIC No Signal Hoodie | Oversized Black
designs.description: Hood sitting on the shoulders, drawstrings with metal tips and a kangaroo pocket. NO SIGNAL over the wordmark on the back with four tear bars, cyan/red banding on the sleeves.

designs.name: STATIC Interference Shirt | All Over TV Noise
designs.description: Dead-channel TV static wrapping the entire garment with no seam — torn scanlines, displaced rows and RGB-split bands circling the torso and both sleeves.

designs.name: STATIC Test Card Shirt | Broadcast Colour Bars
designs.description: Broadcast colour bars wrapping the whole garment, torn through by displaced slices. The bar cycle divides the wrap exactly, so it meets perfectly at every seam.

designs.name: UTILITY Cargo Pants Olive | Baggy Techwear
designs.description: Olive cargos with flapped thigh pockets, buckle tabs and drawstring hems on both legs. Belt loops and a buckle on the waistband.

designs.name: LIGHT WASH Baggy Jeans | Y2K Denim Pants
designs.description: Light wash baggy jeans with whiskering across the thighs, gold topstitched seams, back pockets and a leather brand tab. Matches almost any shirt in this drop.

designs.name: TRACK STRIPE Pants Black | Retro Sport Bottoms
designs.description: Black track pants with red and white stripes down the outer side of both legs, ribbed ankle cuffs and a drawstring waist.

designs.name: MIDNIGHT Suit Trousers | Formal Charcoal Pants
designs.description: Charcoal trousers with a pressed crease down each leg, belt and buckle at the waist and clean side seams. Built to match the Midnight blazer.

designs.name: TARTAN Pleated Skirt + Knee Socks | School Fit
designs.description: Navy tartan pleated skirt with a bare knee gap and striped white knee socks below. The gap shows your own body colour, so it matches any skin tone.

designs.name: RIPPED Baggy Jeans | Distressed Knee Holes
designs.description: Mid-wash baggy jeans with genuinely transparent rips at the knees, frayed white threads across the holes and a frayed hem. Whiskering, gold stitching and back pockets.

designs.name: PASTEL Shorts + Striped Knee Socks | Soft Girl
designs.description: Lilac cuffed shorts with a bare leg gap and pink-and-lilac striped knee socks. Hearts on the thighs and a bow at the waist.

designs.name: CHAIN Black Ripped Jeans | Emo Wallet Chain
designs.description: Black jeans with silver chains looping down the outer leg, ripped knees that show through, a studded belt and dark topstitching.

designs.name: Y2K Low-Rise Flare Jeans | Butterfly Bedazzled
designs.description: Light wash flares with shading that widens toward the hem, butterfly prints on the thigh, contrast stitching and a rhinestone-studded low waistband.

designs.name: GLAMOUR Velour Track Pants | Y2K Matching Set
designs.description: Hot pink velour bottoms with white side piping, ribbed ankle cuffs, a drawstring waist and rhinestone lettering down the leg. Made to match the velour zip top.

designs.name: CAMEL Pleated Trousers | Old Money Tailoring
designs.description: Camel tailored trousers with front pleats, a pressed crease down each leg, turn-up cuffs and a leather belt. Wears with the cricket knit or the linen shirt.

designs.name: TOBACCO Corduroy Trousers | Country Old Money
designs.description: Tobacco brown corduroy with fine vertical wales, a turn-up hem, back pockets and a brass buckle belt. Built to sit under the quilted field jacket.

designs.name: INFERNO Flame Wrap Pants | All Over Fire Print
designs.description: Fire climbs from the ankle and circles both legs and the hips continuously. Ribbed ankle cuffs. Built to match the Inferno shirt as a full set.

designs.name: NEBULA Galaxy Wrap Pants | All Over Space Print
designs.description: The same nebula circling both legs and the hips with no break. Ribbed ankle cuffs. Wears as a full space set with the Nebula shirt.

designs.name: MAGMA Lava Crack Pants | Glowing Cracked Rock
designs.description: Lava veins running through black rock, wrapping both legs continuously. Ribbed ankle cuffs. Completes the Magma set.

designs.name: OVERCLOCK Circuit Pants | Neon Tech All Over
designs.description: Circuit traces and chips glowing around both legs with no seam. Ribbed ankle cuffs. Matches the Overclock shirt.

designs.name: LIQUID CHROME Pants | Iridescent Oil Slick
designs.description: The same molten chrome wrapping both legs continuously. Ribbed ankle cuffs. Full set with the Liquid Chrome shirt.

designs.name: SPRINGVELD Rugby Shorts + Hooped Socks | SA Kit
designs.description: Green rugby shorts with a gold side stripe and hem trim, a bare knee gap, then hooped green-and-gold socks below. Completes the full match kit with either jersey.

designs.name: STATIC Utility Pants | Black Tech Bottoms
designs.description: Black utility pants with flapped thigh panels, a signal-tear band across each leg, STATIC printed down the outer seam and cyan/red banding above the ankle cuff.

designs.name: STATIC Interference Pants | All Over TV Noise
designs.description: The same dead-channel noise circling both legs and the hips unbroken. Ribbed ankle cuffs and a logo hit on the seat. Full set with the Interference shirt.

designs.name: STATIC Test Card Pants | Broadcast Colour Bars
designs.description: Colour bars wrapping both legs with matched seams, torn by displaced slices. Ribbed ankle cuffs. Completes the Test Card set.
